Treatment summary
Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with a distal radius fracture sustained when bracing
a fall against the vehicle. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported event, and the presenting
complaints were appropriate for this type of trauma. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly confirmed the
fracture, with focal tenderness, swelling, and restricted wrist motion on the injured side. Closed reduction was
performed and the wrist was immobilized in a cast, followed by a structured course of hand therapy. The patient
attended 27 visits over the course of care, which ran somewhat longer than is typical for an uncomplicated fracture of
this kind, largely due to stiffness and gradual progression of range-of-motion recovery. The chart notes a remote,
minor strain involving the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation and did not affect the current
presentation. Billing records reviewed alongside the clinical notes show no duplicate or repeated charges for the
same services.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
